assignment: BACSE344 Cloud Infrastructure and Architecture - Digital Assignment 3
task: Question 1(c) - Failure Handling During Sustained Load

baseline_experiment.nginx_configuration: proxy_next_upstream off; standard upstream without aggressive failover
baseline_experiment.failure_analysis: When spacesync-backend-2 was stopped mid-run without upstream retry directives (proxy_next_upstream off), in-flight and queued connections targeted at backend-2 stalled until the proxy connect timeout expired, returning HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout. 15 requests were dropped.

resilience_experiment.nginx_configuration: proxy_next_upstream error timeout http_502 http_503 http_504; max_fails=1 fail_timeout=5s; proxy_connect_timeout 1s; proxy_next_upstream_tries 3; proxy_next_upstream_timeout 5s;
resilience_experiment.resilience_analysis: With passive failure detection and proxy retry directives enabled, Nginx immediately detected the dead connection to backend-2 in <= 1s, transparently retried the request on backend-1 and backend-3, and evicted backend-2 for 5s. 100% of requests succeeded with 0 dropped requests.
